title: Subset Cech total construction and coefficient-map coordinates
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme], $r\geq0$, $f:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$, $V=\bigcup_iD(f_i)$ and $D_S=D(\prod_{j\in S}f_j)$. Let $J,I$ be arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complexes of module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] and $g:J\to I$ a chain map. Suppose $T$ is a complex of $A$-modules with degreewise isomorphisms $\tau_n:T^n\cong\prod_{\varnothing\ne S\subseteq\operatorname{Fin}(r)}\Gamma(D_S,J^{n+1-|S|})$. Its differential has vertical term $(-1)^{|S|-1}d_J$ and horizontal term the sum over $j\in S$ of restriction from $D_{S\setminus\{j\}}$, with sign $(-1)^{|\{i\in S:i<j\}|}$; empty deletions contribute zero. Supply a complex $K_1$ and degreewise isomorphisms $\sigma_{1,n}:K_1^n\cong\Gamma(V,I^n)$ identifying its differential with that of $I$. All restriction inequalities and coefficient-degree transports are exactly those displayed in the Lean signature. Then there exist a complex $T_1$, isomorphisms $\tau_{1,n}:T_1^n\cong\prod_{\varnothing\ne S\subseteq\operatorname{Fin}(r)}\Gamma(D_S,I^{n+1-|S|})$, and chain maps $\alpha_1:K_1\to T_1$ and $b:T\to T_1$. The differential of $T_1$ has the same signed formula with $I$ replacing $J$, $\alpha_1$ is singleton restriction and zero elsewhere, and the $S$-coordinate of $b$ in total degree $n$ is section evaluation of $g^{n+1-|S|}$. No source section complex, source augmentation, section comparison map, injectivity, K-injectivity, homotopy, quasi-isomorphism, or commutative-square assumption or conclusion occurs.

proof.text: Construct T₁ and its degreewise coordinates using the signed-complex existence theorem. Apply the singleton-augmentation theorem to this same T₁ and the given section complex. Apply the coefficient-map theorem to the source and this same target. Combine these witnesses and their three coordinate identities into the required existential conjunction.

theorem principalOpenCech_coordinate_map_exists
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (J : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (I : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (g : J ⟶ I) :
    let V : (Spec (.of A)).Opens := ⨆ i : Fin r, PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (f i)
    let D : Finset (Fin r) → (Spec (.of A)).Opens :=
      fun S ↦ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (∏ j ∈ S, f j)
    ∀ (T : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
      (τ : ∀ n : ℤ, T.X n ≅ ModuleCat.of A
        (∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty},
          (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.obj (op (D S.val))))
      (hle : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), D S ≤ D (S.erase j))
      (hls : ∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}, S.val.card = 1 → D S.val ≤ V)
      (he : ∀ (S : Finset (Fin r)) (j : Fin r), j ∈ S → ∀ n : ℤ,
        n + 1 - ((S.erase j).card : ℤ) = n + 1 + 1 - (S.card : ℤ))
      (hes : ∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}, S.val.card = 1 → ∀ n : ℤ,
        n = n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ))
      (K₁ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
      (σ₁ : ∀ n : ℤ, K₁.X n ≅ (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (I.X n)).obj.obj (op V)),
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (s : T.X n) (S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}),
        (τ (n + 1)).hom (T.d n (n + 1) s) S =
          (-1 : A) ^ (S.val.card - 1) •
            (modulesSpecToSheaf.map
              (J.d (n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)) (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).hom.app
                (op (D S.val)) ((τ n).hom s S) +
          ∑ j : S.val, if h : (S.val.erase j.val).Nonempty then
            (-1 : A) ^ ((S.val.filter (fun i ↦ i < j.val)).card) •
              (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (J.X (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.map
                (homOfLE (hle S.val j.val)).op
                ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map
                  (eqToHom (congrArg J.X (he S.val j.val j.property n)))).hom.app
                    (op (D (S.val.erase j.val))) ((τ n).hom s ⟨S.val.erase j.val, h⟩))
          else 0) →
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (s : K₁.X n),
        (σ₁ (n + 1)).hom (K₁.d n (n + 1) s) =
          (modulesSpecToSheaf.map (I.d n (n + 1))).hom.app (op V) ((σ₁ n).hom s)) →
      ∃ (T₁ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
      (τ₁ : ∀ n : ℤ, T₁.X n ≅ ModuleCat.of A
        (∀ S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty},
          (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (I.X (n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.obj (op (D S.val))))
        (α₁ : K₁ ⟶ T₁) (b : T ⟶ T₁),
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (s : T₁.X n) (S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}),
        (τ₁ (n + 1)).hom (T₁.d n (n + 1) s) S =
          (-1 : A) ^ (S.val.card - 1) •
            (modulesSpecToSheaf.map
              (I.d (n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)) (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).hom.app
                (op (D S.val)) ((τ₁ n).hom s S) +
          ∑ j : S.val, if h : (S.val.erase j.val).Nonempty then
            (-1 : A) ^ ((S.val.filter (fun i ↦ i < j.val)).card) •
              (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (I.X (n + 1 + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.map
                (homOfLE (hle S.val j.val)).op
                ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map
                  (eqToHom (congrArg I.X (he S.val j.val j.property n)))).hom.app
                    (op (D (S.val.erase j.val))) ((τ₁ n).hom s ⟨S.val.erase j.val, h⟩))
          else 0) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (s : K₁.X n) (S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}),
        (τ₁ n).hom (α₁.f n s) S = if h : S.val.card = 1 then
          (modulesSpecToSheaf.obj (I.X (n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).obj.map
            (homOfLE (hls S h)).op
            ((modulesSpecToSheaf.map (eqToHom (congrArg I.X (hes S h n)))).hom.app
              (op V) ((σ₁ n).hom s)) else 0) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℤ) (s : T.X n) (S : {S : Finset (Fin r) // S.Nonempty}),
        (τ₁ n).hom (b.f n s) S =
          (modulesSpecToSheaf.map (g.f (n + 1 - (S.val.card : ℤ)))).hom.app
            (op (D S.val)) ((τ n).hom s S))
